integrity: A self-contained standard-library finite checker and output are included; all-parameter proof uses explicit normalized cocycles for every coefficient abelian group. No independent mathematical audit or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem determines only H_1 of open neighborhood complexes for all m,n>=3; does not classify fundamental groups, higher homology, width <=2, or complete homotopy types. Previously known four-by-four case is explicitly credited. Finite checks corroborate but do not replace symbolic all-coefficient proof; potential unindexed priority remains.
title: The first integral homology of all rectangular rook-graph neighborhood complexes
